title: Brother Simon's brass band playing and the Frazier relatives
summary: Simon played bass drum and sousaphone in brass bands, and Lawrence followed him; an uncle was a piano tuner and a cousin a piano player.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Um, let's see if I can think of anything else, or if you can think of anything else really, about your father. Um, I don't suppose you ever played anything in, uh, brass bands, any, some of those fellows that play like bass drum or something in a brass band like you did, you know?
Well, uh, Bill, uh, my brother Simon, he was a bass drum player and also a sousaphone player
Oh, Simon. Yeah, Simon, he plays, how do you call it, Pelican, Helican?
Yeah, he did play that in brass band and, uh, he also played bass drum. That's why I took it up behind him.
You don't remember your father ever playing bass drum? No, no, no, my dad played bass drum, never did, no Bill.
Nothing. He might have played, but I never remember him playing no bass drum.
Did any of your uncles or aunts play anything too, and the members of the Frazier family?

Yes, Bill, I had an uncle, he was a piano tuner. Well then he played bass violin also, Michelle Frazier. Piano tuner? He's a piano tuner and he rappelled. Yeah. And his son, he had a son called Mitchell Frazier, was a great piano player. Not musical, just head, you know?
